constructed_states.meaning: the run's stability of every member a constructor's stated result state names (rules 12o, 13w, 14e): every store into the member in every analysed unit is classified (a store into an object its function obtained from an owned-result call only or an automatic object, a null pointer into a function-pointer member, a constant flag-or, a case-guarded rewrite); anything else, a whole-object write of the record, or a unit that recorded no facts (premise P-OPCTOR-STORES-SEEN) leaves it not kept. `demoted` lists the Safe or Pending rows resting on a constructor whose stated member the run does not keep, now Unknown (constructed-state-open). Evidence and a demotion only: no row is promoted

meaning: the run's closure of every function-pointer member a resource_callback_member_invoked clause names (rule 12n): over every analysed unit's Clang stores into the member, a designator joins the set, a null pointer adds nothing, a read of another such member adds its set, a formal of a function whose address no unit takes adds its actuals at every call, and anything else opens it; a unit that recorded no facts opens it (premise P-CG22-MEMBER-CLOSED-WORLD). `demoted` lists the Safe or Pending rows whose unit decided a member over a set the run's closure is not contained in, now Unknown (callback-member-open). `members_over_recorded_units` is the same closure over the units that did record facts, and `units_without_facts_named` names the others (evidence only). Evidence and a demotion only: no row is promoted
